stories.headline: SEC to consider termination of LSU's membership at Dec. 3 meeting
stories.desc: For the second time this year, the SEC is threatening to hold a vote of its chancellors and presidents on whether to kick LSU out of the league, according to a filing in federal court in Alabama on Monday.
